successors.text: the island of Pohnpei, with its divisions including Ant Atoll and Pakin Island (Saudeleur dynasty page); Natural Earth's Pohnpei admin-1 is the island

ledger.x: c. 1100: the Saudeleur dynasty unites Pohnpei from Nan Madol. The page: the dynasty ruled 'from c. 1100-1200 CE to c. 1628 CE', 'is thought to have emerged in the 12th century, though exact dates remain uncertain', and was 'the first organized government uniting the people of Pohnpei island'; the Pohnpei page's period…

c. 1628: Isokelekel overthrows the Saudeleurs and the Nahnmwarki era begins. Infobox 'conquest by Isokelekel, c. 1628' ('Legend generally dates their downfall to the 1500s' while 'archaeologists date Saudeleur ruins to ca. 1628'); Isokelekel replaced Saudeleur rule with 'the more decentralized nahnmwarki system'. Same…
1886: Spain founds Santiago de la Ascensión at Kolonia.

certainty.note: A single island: the coast is the border.
